kind: local focused development measurement of the units classified after the 2026-11-20 records (the research modules of the pipeline-level and acquisition work); not the controller campaign, not attested
note: No survivor was marked equivalent. Timed-out mutants are counted as unresolved (listed under survived). While the tests were hardened, several survivor classes were found to be equivalent in effect (zip(strict=...) between lists of equal length, print(flush=...), rng.choice(replace=None) which numpy reads as False, float('NAN') against float('nan'), None against np.nan in a float column, an argument equal to the default of the called function, a comparison whose boundary is unreachable in floating point); they are not removed from the counts, and where a construct produced several of them it was rewritten (index loops, a shared sampling helper, defaults dropped) so that fewer remain. The argument parsers of eight modules were moved into build_parser() functions, without a change of behaviour, so that their defaults are tested. The survivors of the final runs were not individually triaged.
